```{r Project Setup, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# This chunk now sets up paths using the global project_dirs object
library(tidyverse)
library(purrr)
library(flextable)
library(here)
library(patchwork)
library(viridis)
library(gt)
library(plotly)
library(glue)
library(webshot2)
# Explicitly load key tidyverse sub-packages for knitr environment robustness
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

# Ensure global project_dirs object exists
if (!exists("project_dirs", envir = .GlobalEnv) || !is.list(project_dirs)) {
  stop("Global object 'project_dirs' not found or is not a list. Run MultiScholaR::setupDirectories() first.")
}
# Use the getProjectPaths helper function which handles key fallback
# This works with both RMarkdown format (omic_type_label) and Shiny format (omic_type)
if (!exists("getProjectPaths", mode = "function")) {
  stop("getProjectPaths function not found. Ensure MultiScholaR package is loaded.")
}

current_project_paths <- tryCatch({
  getProjectPaths(
    omic_type = params$omic_type,
    experiment_label = params$experiment_label,
    project_dirs_object_name = "project_dirs",
    env = .GlobalEnv
  )
}, error = function(e) {
  stop(glue::glue("Failed to get project paths for omic_type='{params$omic_type}', experiment_label='{params$experiment_label}': {e$message}"))
})

# Verify we got valid paths
if (is.null(current_project_paths) || !is.list(current_project_paths)) {
  stop("getProjectPaths returned NULL or invalid data. Check project_dirs setup.")
}

# Define commonly used paths for this report for convenience
report_source_dir             <- current_project_paths$source_dir
report_results_summary_dir    <- current_project_paths$results_summary_dir
report_qc_figures_dir         <- current_project_paths$qc_figures_dir
report_publication_figures_dir<- current_project_paths$publication_figures_dir
report_publication_tables_dir <- current_project_paths$publication_tables_dir

# Basic validation (more can be added if needed)
if (!dir.exists(report_source_dir)) stop(glue::glue("Report source directory not found: {report_source_dir}"))
if (!dir.exists(report_results_summary_dir)) stop(glue::glue("Report results summary directory not found: {report_results_summary_dir}"))

# Define the safe default operator %||% (needed by restored ExtractStudyParameters)
`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (!is.null(a)) a else b
```

```{r New Hierarchical Parser, echo=FALSE}
# NEW: Hierarchical parser for the updated study_parameters.txt format
ReadStudyParamsNew <- function(filepath) {
  if (!file.exists(filepath)) {
    stop(glue::glue("Study parameters file not found: {filepath}"))
  }
  
  lines <- readLines(filepath, warn = FALSE)
  params <- list()
  
  # State variables for hierarchical parsing
  main_section <- NULL
  sub_section <- NULL
  config_block <- NULL
  in_contrasts <- FALSE
  
  for (line in lines) {
    original_line <- line
    line <- trimws(line)
    
    # Skip empty lines, separator lines, and title
    if (line == "" || grepl("^=+$", line) || grepl("^-+$", line) || 
        line == "Study Parameters" || grepl("^#+", line)) {
      next
    }
    
    # Detect main sections (e.g., "Basic Information:", "Git Information:")
    if (grepl(":$", line) && !grepl("^[[:space:]]", original_line)) {
      main_section <- trimws(sub(":$", "", line))
      params[[main_section]] <- list()
      sub_section <- NULL
      config_block <- NULL
      in_contrasts <- (main_section == "Contrasts")
      next
    }
    
    # Detect sub-sections (e.g., "Parameters from Final S4 Object:")
    if (grepl(":$", line) && grepl("^[[:space:]]+", original_line)) {
      sub_section <- trimws(sub(":$", "", line))
      if (!is.null(main_section)) {
        if (is.null(params[[main_section]])) {
          params[[main_section]] <- list()
        }
        params[[main_section]][[sub_section]] <- list()
      }
      config_block <- NULL
      next
    }
    
    # Detect config blocks (e.g., "[globalParameters]")
    if (grepl("^\\[.*\\]$", line)) {
      config_block <- gsub("\\[|\\]", "", line)
      # Place under appropriate section context
      if (!is.null(sub_section) && !is.null(main_section)) {
        params[[main_section]][[sub_section]][[config_block]] <- list()
      } else if (!is.null(main_section)) {
        params[[main_section]][[config_block]] <- list()
      }
      next
    }
    
    # Handle contrasts (special case - array of values)
    if (in_contrasts && main_section == "Contrasts") {
      # Contrasts are just lines of text, not key-value pairs
      if (line != "" && !grepl("^-+$", line)) {
        if (is.list(params[[main_section]]) && length(params[[main_section]]) == 0) {
          params[[main_section]] <- c(trimws(line))
        } else {
          params[[main_section]] <- c(params[[main_section]], trimws(line))
        }
      }
      next
    }
    
    # Handle bullet points (e.g., "• Best percentage: 19.0%"; the writer emits "* Best k value: 2", KIT-039 fix:
    # until then the "*" bullet stayed in the key and every RUV optimisation value read as missing)
    if (grepl("^[•*]", line)) {
      # Remove bullet and parse as key-value
      line <- sub("^[•*][[:space:]]*", "", line)
    }
    
    # Handle key-value pairs (can use : or =)
    if (grepl("[=:]", line)) {
      # Split on first occurrence of = or :
      split_char <- if (grepl("=", line)) "=" else ":"
      parts <- stringr::str_split_fixed(line, split_char, 2)
      key <- trimws(parts[1, 1])
      value <- trimws(parts[1, 2])
      
      # Clean up key (remove any remaining bullets)
      key <- sub("^[•*[:space:]]+", "", key)
      
      # Only process if we have a valid key
      if (nchar(key) > 0) {
        # Determine where to store based on current context
        if (!is.null(config_block) && !is.null(sub_section) && !is.null(main_section)) {
          params[[main_section]][[sub_section]][[config_block]][[key]] <- value
        } else if (!is.null(sub_section) && !is.null(main_section)) {
          params[[main_section]][[sub_section]][[key]] <- value
        } else if (!is.null(main_section)) {
          params[[main_section]][[key]] <- value
        }
      }
    }
  }
  
  return(params)
}

# NEW: Safe parameter extraction with path navigation
safe_extract <- function(params, path, default = NULL) {
  if (is.null(params) || is.null(path)) return(default)
  
  # Handle pipe-separated paths
  if (is.character(path) && length(path) == 1 && grepl("\\|", path)) {
    path_parts <- strsplit(path, "\\|")[[1]]
  } else if (is.character(path)) {
    path_parts <- path
  } else {
    return(default)
  }
  
  current <- params
  for (part in path_parts) {
    part <- trimws(part)
    if (is.list(current) && part %in% names(current)) {
      current <- current[[part]]
    } else {
      return(default)
    }
  }
  
  return(current)
}

# NEW: Enhanced parameter extraction for new format
ExtractStudyParametersNew <- function(study_params) {
  
  # Extract from different sections of the new hierarchical structure
  basic_info <- study_params$"Basic Information" %||% list()
  git_info <- study_params$"Git Information" %||% list()
  ruv_results <- study_params$"Automatic RUV Optimization Results" %||% list()
  ruv_batch_correction <- study_params$"RUV-III Batch Correction" %||% list()
  fasta_info <- study_params$"FASTA File Processing" %||% list()
  accession_cleanup <- study_params$"Protein Accession Cleanup" %||% list()
  protein_counts_info <- study_params$"Protein Filtering Summary" %||% list()
  
  # NEW: Extract mixed species FASTA analysis info
  mixed_species_info <- study_params$"Mixed Species FASTA Analysis" %||% list()
  enrichment_filter_info <- study_params$"Enrichment Analysis - Organism Filtering" %||% list()
  
  # Navigate to S4 parameters
  s4_params <- safe_extract(study_params, c("Workflow Parameters", "Parameters from Final S4 Object"), list())
  
  # Navigate to UI parameters
  ui_params <- safe_extract(study_params, c("Workflow Parameters", "User Interface Parameters"), list())
  
  # Extract contrasts
  contrasts <- study_params$"Contrasts" %||% character(0)
  
  # Extract S4 parameter sections
  s4_global <- s4_params$globalParameters %||% list()
  s4_qval <- s4_params$srlQvalueProteotypicPeptideClean %||% list()
  s4_pep_filt <- s4_params$peptideIntensityFiltering %||% list()
  s4_prot_filt <- s4_params$removeRowsWithMissingValuesPercent %||% list()
  s4_pep_prot_filt <- s4_params$filterMinNumPeptidesPerProtein %||% list()
  s4_sample_filt <- s4_params$filterMinNumPeptidesPerSample %||% list()
  s4_norm <- s4_params$normaliseBetweenSamples %||% list()
  s4_ruv <- s4_params$ruvIII_C_Varying %||% list()
  s4_de <- s4_params$deAnalysisParameters %||% list()
  
  # Extract sample filtering information
  samples_removed <- s4_sample_filt$samples_removed %||% character(0)
  samples_removed_count <- s4_sample_filt$samples_removed_count %||% 0
  samples_before_count <- s4_sample_filt$samples_before_count %||% NA
  samples_after_count <- s4_sample_filt$samples_after_count %||% NA
  
  # Extract UI parameter sections
  # KIT-236 (P03): the DA UI block under the name the writer gives it ("Differential Expression"), else the
  # older name; files of every earlier version keep reading.
  ui_de <- safe_extract(ui_params, "Differential Abundance UI Parameters", NULL) %||%
    safe_extract(ui_params, "Differential Expression UI Parameters", list())
  ui_enrich <- safe_extract(ui_params, "Enrichment Analysis UI Parameters", list())
  
  # Create flat parameter list for backward compatibility
  all_params <- list(
    # Basic Information
    workflow_name = basic_info$"Workflow Name",
    description = basic_info$"Description", 
    timestamp = basic_info$"Timestamp",
    
    # Git Information
    repository = git_info$"Repository",
    branch = git_info$"Branch",
    commit = git_info$"Commit",
    git_timestamp = git_info$"Git Timestamp",
    
    # RUV Status (check both sections for backwards compatibility)
    ruv_applied = if (!is.null(ruv_batch_correction$"Status")) {
      tolower(trimws(ruv_batch_correction$"Status")) != "not applied"
    } else if (!is.null(ruv_results$"Best k value")) {
      TRUE
    } else {
      NA # KIT-227: neither section: not recorded (was FALSE, printed as 'not applied')
    },
    
    # RUV Auto-optimisation Results (only populated when RUV was applied)
    best_percentage = sub("%$", "", ruv_results$"Best percentage" %||% NA_character_), # the file writes "10.0%"; the sentence appends its own %
    best_k = ruv_results$"Best k value",
    separation_score = ruv_results$"Separation score",
    composite_score = ruv_results$"Composite score", 
    num_neg_ctrl = ruv_results$"Control genes",
    ruv_grouping_variable = ruv_results$"RUV grouping variable",
    ruv_separation_metric = ruv_results$"Separation metric", # KIT-227: 'manual' for a manual run
    
    # Method Details from S4 parameters (FIXED: explicit NULL check for 0 values)
    qvalue_threshold = if(is.null(s4_qval$qvalue_threshold) || is.na(s4_qval$qvalue_threshold)) 0.01 else as.numeric(s4_qval$qvalue_threshold),
    proteotypic_peptide_only = as.logical(as.numeric(s4_qval$choose_only_proteotypic_peptide %||% 1)),
    intensity_cutoff_percentile = if(is.null(s4_pep_filt$peptides_intensity_cutoff_percentile) || is.na(s4_pep_filt$peptides_intensity_cutoff_percentile)) 1 else as.numeric(s4_pep_filt$peptides_intensity_cutoff_percentile),
    proportion_samples_below_cutoff = if(is.null(s4_pep_filt$peptides_proportion_of_samples_below_cutoff) || is.na(s4_pep_filt$peptides_proportion_of_samples_below_cutoff)) 0.5 else as.numeric(s4_pep_filt$peptides_proportion_of_samples_below_cutoff),
    missing_values_cutoff = if(is.null(s4_prot_filt$groupwise_percentage_cutoff) || is.na(s4_prot_filt$groupwise_percentage_cutoff)) 33.333 else as.numeric(s4_prot_filt$groupwise_percentage_cutoff),
    max_groups_percentage_cutoff = if(is.null(s4_prot_filt$max_groups_percentage_cutoff) || is.na(s4_prot_filt$max_groups_percentage_cutoff)) 0 else as.numeric(s4_prot_filt$max_groups_percentage_cutoff),
    min_peptidoforms_per_protein = if(is.null(s4_pep_prot_filt$peptidoforms_per_protein_cutoff) || is.na(s4_pep_prot_filt$peptidoforms_per_protein_cutoff)) 2 else as.numeric(s4_pep_prot_filt$peptidoforms_per_protein_cutoff),
    min_peptides_per_sample = if(is.null(s4_sample_filt$peptides_per_sample_cutoff) || is.na(s4_sample_filt$peptides_per_sample_cutoff)) 500 else as.numeric(s4_sample_filt$peptides_per_sample_cutoff),
    samples_removed = samples_removed,
    samples_removed_count = samples_removed_count,
    samples_before_count = samples_before_count,
    samples_after_count = samples_after_count,
    normalisation_method = s4_norm$method %||% s4_norm$normalisation_method %||% "cyclicloess",
    
    # RUV parameters (FIXED: explicit NULL check)
    ruv_number_k = if(is.null(s4_ruv$ruv_number_k) || is.na(s4_ruv$ruv_number_k)) 2 else as.numeric(s4_ruv$ruv_number_k),
    
    # DE Analysis S4 parameters (FIXED: explicit NULL checks)
    s4_de_q_val_thresh = if(is.null(s4_de$de_q_val_thresh) || is.na(s4_de$de_q_val_thresh)) 0.05 else as.numeric(s4_de$de_q_val_thresh),
    s4_de_treat_lfc_cutoff = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(s4_de$treat_lfc_cutoff %||% NA_real_)), # KIT-236: NA = not recorded
    s4_ebayes_trend = as.logical(s4_de$eBayes_trend %||% TRUE),
    s4_ebayes_robust = as.logical(s4_de$eBayes_robust %||% TRUE),
    s4_formula_string = s4_de$formula_string %||% "~ 0 + group",
    
    # UI Parameters (FIXED: explicit NULL checks)
    ui_de_q_value_threshold = if(is.null(ui_de$q_value_threshold) || is.na(ui_de$q_value_threshold)) 0.05 else as.numeric(ui_de$q_value_threshold),
    ui_de_log_fold_change_cutoff = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(ui_de$log_fold_change_cutoff %||% NA_real_)), # KIT-236: NA = not recorded
    ui_de_treat_enabled = suppressWarnings(as.logical(ui_de$treat_enabled %||% NA)), # KIT-236: NA = not recorded
    
    ui_enrichment_up_lfc = if(is.null(ui_enrich$up_log2fc_cutoff) || is.na(ui_enrich$up_log2fc_cutoff)) 0 else as.numeric(ui_enrich$up_log2fc_cutoff),
    ui_enrichment_down_lfc = if(is.null(ui_enrich$down_log2fc_cutoff) || is.na(ui_enrich$down_log2fc_cutoff)) 0 else as.numeric(ui_enrich$down_log2fc_cutoff),
    ui_enrichment_q_value_cutoff = if(is.null(ui_enrich$q_value_cutoff) || is.na(ui_enrich$q_value_cutoff)) 0.05 else as.numeric(ui_enrich$q_value_cutoff),
    ui_enrichment_organism_selected = ui_enrich$organism_selected,
    ui_enrichment_database_source = ui_enrich$database_source %||% "N/A",
    
    # FASTA Processing (with safe extraction)
    fasta_format = fasta_info$"Format" %||% NA,
    fasta_num_sequences = fasta_info$"Sequences" %||% NA,
    fasta_has_protein_evidence = fasta_info$"Protein Evidence Available" %||% NA,
    fasta_has_gene_names = fasta_info$"Gene Names Available" %||% NA,
    fasta_has_isoform_info = fasta_info$"Isoform Information Available" %||% NA,
    
    # Accession Cleanup (with safe extraction)
    accession_cleanup_applied = accession_cleanup$"Cleanup Applied" %||% NA,
    accession_aggregation_method = accession_cleanup$"Aggregation Method" %||% NA,
    accession_delimiter = accession_cleanup$"Delimiter Used" %||% NA,
    accession_proteins_before = accession_cleanup$"Proteins Before Cleanup" %||% NA,
    accession_proteins_after = accession_cleanup$"Proteins After Cleanup" %||% NA,
    accession_had_full_metadata = accession_cleanup$"Full UniProt Metadata" %||% NA,
    
    # Protein Counts (with safe extraction)
    protein_count_qc = protein_counts_info$"Proteins after QC filtering" %||% NA,
    protein_count_ruv = protein_counts_info$"Proteins after RUV filtering" %||% NA,
    protein_count_final = protein_counts_info$"Final proteins for DA analysis" %||% NA,
    
    # NEW: Mixed Species FASTA Analysis
    mixed_species_enabled = mixed_species_info$"Multi-Species FASTA Used" %||% "No",
    mixed_species_primary_organism = mixed_species_info$"Selected Primary Organism" %||% NA,
    mixed_species_taxon_id = mixed_species_info$"Selected Taxon ID" %||% NA,
    mixed_species_filtered_at_import = mixed_species_info$"Filtered at Import" %||% "No",
    
    # NEW: Enrichment Organism Filtering
    enrichment_filter_enabled = enrichment_filter_info$"Filter Applied" %||% "No",
    enrichment_filter_proteins_before = enrichment_filter_info$"Proteins Before" %||% NA,
    enrichment_filter_proteins_after = enrichment_filter_info$"Proteins After" %||% NA,
    
    # Contrasts
    contrasts = contrasts
  )
  
  # Convert any NULL values to appropriate defaults
  all_params[sapply(all_params, is.null)] <- NA
  
  return(all_params)
}
```

```{r Method Section, echo=FALSE}
# UPDATED: Method details using new parameter structure
FormatMethodDetails <- function(numbers) {
  # Use parameters from new extraction (FIXED: explicit NULL check for 0 values)
  qvalue_thresh <- if(is.null(numbers$qvalue_threshold) || is.na(numbers$qvalue_threshold)) 0.01 else as.numeric(numbers$qvalue_threshold)
  proteotypic_pep_only <- numbers$proteotypic_peptide_only %||% TRUE
  prop_samples_cutoff <- if(is.null(numbers$proportion_samples_below_cutoff) || is.na(numbers$proportion_samples_below_cutoff)) 0.5 else as.numeric(numbers$proportion_samples_below_cutoff)
  intensity_cutoff_pct <- if(is.null(numbers$intensity_cutoff_percentile) || is.na(numbers$intensity_cutoff_percentile)) 1 else as.numeric(numbers$intensity_cutoff_percentile)
  min_peptidoforms <- if(is.null(numbers$min_peptidoforms_per_protein) || is.na(numbers$min_peptidoforms_per_protein)) 2 else as.numeric(numbers$min_peptidoforms_per_protein)
  min_peptides_sample <- if(is.null(numbers$min_peptides_per_sample) || is.na(numbers$min_peptides_per_sample)) 200 else as.numeric(numbers$min_peptides_per_sample)
  missing_vals_cutoff <- if(is.null(numbers$missing_values_cutoff) || is.na(numbers$missing_values_cutoff)) 33.3 else as.numeric(numbers$missing_values_cutoff)
  max_groups_cutoff <- if(is.null(numbers$max_groups_percentage_cutoff) || is.na(numbers$max_groups_percentage_cutoff)) 0 else as.numeric(numbers$max_groups_percentage_cutoff)
  norm_method <- numbers$normalisation_method %||% "cyclicloess"
  
  # RUV parameters from new structure
  best_k_val <- numbers$best_k %||% "auto-determined"
  best_pct_val <- numbers$best_percentage %||% "auto-determined"
  num_neg_ctrl_val <- numbers$num_neg_ctrl %||% "auto-determined"
  
  proportion_pct_text <- paste0(prop_samples_cutoff * 100, "%")
  proteotypic_text <- if (isTRUE(proteotypic_pep_only)) 'only those that are proteotypic' else 'including non-proteotypic peptides'
  
  # Generate FASTA text BEFORE glue block (with robust NULL checks)
  fasta_text <- tryCatch({
    if (!is.null(numbers$fasta_format) && !is.na(numbers$fasta_format) && nzchar(numbers$fasta_format)) {
      if (numbers$fasta_format == "standard_uniprot") {
        "Protein identifications were validated against a standard UniProt FASTA database, providing comprehensive protein metadata including evidence levels, reviewed status, gene names, and isoform information. This metadata was used to select the highest-quality protein identifications during accession cleanup."
      } else {
        paste0("Protein identifications were validated against a ", numbers$fasta_format, 
               " FASTA database containing ", numbers$fasta_num_sequences %||% "N/A", 
               " sequences. Note that comprehensive UniProt metadata (protein evidence levels, reviewed status) was not available for this reference database, and accession selection was based primarily on sequence length and alphabetical ordering.")
      }
    } else {
      "Protein identifications were validated against the provided FASTA reference database."
    }
  }, error = function(e) {
    "Protein identifications were validated against the provided FASTA reference database."
  })
  
  # Generate accession cleanup text BEFORE glue block (with robust NULL checks)
  accession_cleanup_text <- tryCatch({
    cleanup_applied_val <- numbers$accession_cleanup_applied %||% "FALSE"
    # Handle character "TRUE"/"FALSE" or logical TRUE/FALSE
    cleanup_applied <- if (is.character(cleanup_applied_val)) {
      tolower(cleanup_applied_val) == "true"
    } else {
      isTRUE(cleanup_applied_val)
    }
    
    if (cleanup_applied) {
      # Check metadata availability
      has_evidence_val <- numbers$fasta_has_protein_evidence %||% "FALSE"
      has_metadata <- if (is.character(has_evidence_val)) {
        tolower(has_evidence_val) == "true"
      } else {
        isTRUE(has_evidence_val)
      }
      
      metadata_basis <- if (has_metadata) {
        "protein evidence levels, sequence length, and database annotation quality"
      } else {
        "sequence length and alphabetical ordering"
      }
      
      paste0("Protein groups containing multiple accessions (separated by '", 
             numbers$accession_delimiter %||% ";", 
             "' delimiters) were resolved by selecting the best representative protein based on ",
             metadata_basis, 
             ". Quantitative values for proteins within the same group were aggregated using the '",
             numbers$accession_aggregation_method %||% "mean",
             "' method, reducing ",
             numbers$accession_proteins_before %||% "N/A",
             " protein groups to ",
             numbers$accession_proteins_after %||% "N/A",
             " unique protein identifications.")
    } else {
      ""
    }
  }, error = function(e) {
    ""
  })
  
  # Generate protein count text BEFORE glue block
  qc_count_text <- if(!is.null(numbers$protein_count_qc) && !is.na(numbers$protein_count_qc)) {
    paste0(" After quality control filtering, ", numbers$protein_count_qc, " proteins remained for normalisation.")
  } else {
    ""
  }
  
  ruv_count_text <- if(isTRUE(numbers$ruv_applied) && !is.null(numbers$protein_count_ruv) && !is.na(numbers$protein_count_ruv)) { # KIT-227: only after RUV
    paste0(" Following RUV-III batch correction and subsequent missing value cleanup, ", 
           numbers$protein_count_ruv, " proteins were retained for differential abundance analysis.")
  } else {
    ""
  }
  
  # Generate cross-group filtering text BEFORE glue block (KIT-055: one rule, stated once)
  cross_groups_text <- if(max_groups_cutoff == 0) {
    "a protein was retained only if it passed in every experimental group."
  } else {
    paste0("a protein was retained if the share of experimental groups in which it failed did not exceed the allowed share, ", max_groups_cutoff, "% (shown rounded to three decimals).")
  }
  ordinal_suffix <- function(n) { n <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(round(as.numeric(n)))); if (is.na(n)) return("th")
    if (n %% 100 %in% 11:13) "th" else switch(as.character(n %% 10), "1" = "st", "2" = "nd", "3" = "rd", "th") }
  intensity_cutoff_suffix <- ordinal_suffix(intensity_cutoff_pct)
  
  # Generate sample filtering summary text BEFORE glue block
  sample_filter_summary <- ""
  if (!is.null(numbers$samples_before_count) && !is.na(numbers$samples_before_count) && 
      !is.null(numbers$samples_after_count) && !is.na(numbers$samples_after_count)) {
    sample_filter_summary <- paste0(
      " Of ", numbers$samples_before_count, " initial samples, ", 
      numbers$samples_after_count, " samples were retained after filtering."
    )
  }
  
  # Generate removed samples list text BEFORE glue block
  removed_samples_text <- ""
  if (!is.null(numbers$samples_removed) && length(numbers$samples_removed) > 0) {
    removed_samples_text <- paste0(
      " The following samples were removed due to insufficient peptide counts: ", 
      paste(numbers$samples_removed, collapse = ", "), "."
    )
  }

  # KIT-227: the RUV sentence states what was run, by the recorded state: applied, not applied or not recorded (the
  # record's outcome, else the file's sections); the mode (the record's ruv_mode, else the file's separation metric),
  # the analyst's percentage for a manual run and the grouping (the record's, else the file's). A value written as
  # 'N/A' counts as not recorded. Automatic on the 'group' column keeps the earlier text word for word.
  ruv_known <- function(value) !is.null(value) && length(value) == 1L && !is.na(value) &&
    !trimws(as.character(value)) %in% c("", "N/A", "NA", "not recorded")
  ruv_applied_val <- if (isTRUE(numbers$ruv_applied)) TRUE else if (isFALSE(numbers$ruv_applied)) FALSE else NA
  ruv_mode_val <- if (ruv_known(numbers$record_ruv_mode) && numbers$record_ruv_mode %in% c("automatic", "manual")) {
    numbers$record_ruv_mode
  } else if (ruv_known(numbers$ruv_separation_metric)) {
    if (identical(numbers$ruv_separation_metric, "manual")) "manual" else "automatic"
  } else NA
  ruv_pct <- if (identical(ruv_mode_val, "manual") && ruv_known(numbers$record_ruv_percentage)) numbers$record_ruv_percentage else numbers$best_percentage
  ruv_grouping <- if (ruv_known(numbers$record_ruv_grouping)) numbers$record_ruv_grouping else numbers$ruv_grouping_variable
  ruv_other_column <- ruv_known(ruv_grouping) && !identical(as.character(ruv_grouping), "group")
  ruv_groups <- if (!ruv_known(ruv_grouping)) "the sample groups (the design column used is not recorded)" else
    if (ruv_other_column) paste0("the sample groups given by the design column '", ruv_grouping, "'") else "biological groups"
  ruv_controls <- if (ruv_known(numbers$num_neg_ctrl)) paste0(numbers$num_neg_ctrl, " proteins") else "number of proteins not recorded"
  ruv_share <- if (ruv_known(numbers$num_neg_ctrl)) paste0("(not recorded; ", numbers$num_neg_ctrl, " proteins were used)") else
    "(not recorded, nor the number of proteins used)"
  ruv_k_val <- if (ruv_known(numbers$best_k)) numbers$best_k else "an unrecorded number of"
  ruv_detail <- if (identical(ruv_mode_val, "automatic")) {
    if (ruv_known(ruv_pct)) glue::glue(
      "For this study, an automatic ",
      "optimisation process was run, which identified that using {ruv_pct}% of ",
      "features as empirical negative controls ({ruv_controls}) ",
      "provided the best separation of {ruv_groups}. Based on this, ",
      "{ruv_k_val} unwanted components were selected for removal."
    ) else glue::glue(
      "For this study, an automatic optimisation process was run, which selected the share of features used as ",
      "empirical negative controls {ruv_share} that provided the best separation of {ruv_groups}. Based on this, ",
      "{ruv_k_val} unwanted components were selected for removal."
    )
  } else if (identical(ruv_mode_val, "manual")) {
    paste0(if (ruv_known(ruv_pct)) glue::glue(
      "For this study, no automatic optimisation was run: the analyst chose to use {ruv_pct}% of features as empirical ",
      "negative controls ({ruv_controls}) and to remove {ruv_k_val} unwanted components."
    ) else glue::glue(
      "For this study, no automatic optimisation was run: the analyst set the share of features used as empirical ",
      "negative controls {ruv_share} and chose to remove {ruv_k_val} unwanted components."
    ), if (ruv_other_column) paste0(" The controls were chosen by comparing ", ruv_groups, ".") else "")
  } else {
    if (ruv_known(ruv_pct)) glue::glue(
      "For this study, {ruv_pct}% of features were used as empirical negative controls ({ruv_controls}) and {ruv_k_val} ",
      "unwanted components were removed; whether these values came from an automatic optimisation or were set by the ",
      "analyst is not recorded."
    ) else glue::glue(
      "For this study, a share of features {ruv_share} served as empirical negative controls and {ruv_k_val} unwanted ",
      "components were removed; whether these values came from an automatic optimisation or were set by the analyst ",
      "is not recorded."
    )
  }
  
  ruv_text <- if (isTRUE(ruv_applied_val)) {
    paste0(
      "To remove batch effects from biological data, the remove unwanted variation ",
      "(RUVIII-C) method was used. The method relies on having a set of endogenous ",
      "negative control proteins, which are proteins with little or no changes in ",
      "protein abundances between different samples. ", ruv_detail
    )
  } else if (isFALSE(ruv_applied_val)) {
    "RUV-III batch correction was not applied. The analysis proceeded directly with normalised data for differential abundance analysis."
  } else {
    "Whether RUV-III batch correction was applied is not recorded for this analysis."
  }
  
  # NEW: Generate mixed species FASTA text BEFORE glue block
  mixed_species_text <- ""
  if (!is.null(numbers$mixed_species_enabled) && 
      tolower(numbers$mixed_species_enabled) == "yes") {
    mixed_species_text <- paste0(
      "\n\nMixed-Species FASTA Database\n",
      "The analysis used a mixed-species FASTA database containing proteins from ",
      "multiple organisms. The primary organism was identified as ",
      numbers$mixed_species_primary_organism %||% "unknown",
      " (NCBI Taxonomy ID: ", numbers$mixed_species_taxon_id %||% "N/A", ")."
    )
    
    if (tolower(numbers$mixed_species_filtered_at_import %||% "no") == "yes") {
      mixed_species_text <- paste0(mixed_species_text,
        " Proteins from non-target organisms were filtered at the import stage."
      )
    }
    
    if (tolower(numbers$enrichment_filter_enabled %||% "no") == "yes" &&
        !is.na(numbers$enrichment_filter_proteins_before)) {
      mixed_species_text <- paste0(mixed_species_text,
        " For enrichment analysis, additional organism filtering was applied, ",
        "reducing the protein set from ", numbers$enrichment_filter_proteins_before,
        " to ", numbers$enrichment_filter_proteins_after, " proteins."
      )
    }
  }

  glue::glue("
METHOD DETAILS  

Data analyses were performed with MultiScholaR; the software version and build are listed under 'Software and build'. 
SOP reference: [to be completed by the analyst].  

**Data import, filtering and normalisation**

Precursor-level identifications and quantities were imported from the DIA-NN main report 
(one row per precursor and run). Peptide and protein quantification was then performed using a series of filtering and 
aggregation steps to ensure high-confidence identifications and accurate 
quantification. Initially, low-confidence peptide identifications were removed 
using q-value and proteotypic peptide filtering, retaining only peptides with a 
q-value threshold of {qvalue_thresh} and 
{proteotypic_text}. Precursor ion intensities were then 
aggregated into peptide-level quantification values, combining all charge states 
of the same peptide sequence while keeping different modified peptides 
(peptidoforms) as separate entries.

Intensity threshold filtering was applied to remove peptides where a significant 
proportion of samples fell below a specified log-intensity threshold. By default, 
peptides were excluded if {proportion_pct_text} or more 
of the samples were below the lowest {intensity_cutoff_pct}st 
percentile of intensity values. Proteins were required to have a minimum of 
{min_peptidoforms} peptides, which could include different 
modifications of the same sequence, to be considered for further analysis.

**Sample quality control and filtering**

Samples with poor performance, indicated by an unusually low number of identified 
peptides, were identified and removed to ensure data quality and reliable downstream 
analysis. Such samples may be compromised due to issues in sample preparation, 
instrument performance, or other technical factors. Including these low-quality samples 
in downstream analysis could introduce bias and reduce the statistical power to detect 
true biological differences. Samples with fewer than {min_peptides_sample} peptides 
were excluded from further analysis. This minimum peptide threshold ensures that all 
retained samples have sufficient protein coverage for reliable quantification and 
statistical testing.{sample_filter_summary}{removed_samples_text}

Peptides appearing in only one replicate across all groups were also excluded to 
maintain measurement reproducibility. Protein-level quantification was performed using 
the IQ algorithm, implementing the maxLFQ algorithm to generate protein abundance 
values. Peptide intensities were aggregated into protein-level quantification without 
normalisation at this stage, resulting in a protein quantification matrix with 
log2-transformed intensity values for each protein across all samples.

**FASTA reference and protein accession cleanup**

{fasta_text}

{accession_cleanup_text}{mixed_species_text}{qc_count_text}

Using the protein intensity matrix, zero values were replaced with NA denoting 
these are missing values. Protein filtering was then applied based on missing 
value patterns and intensity thresholds to ensure robust statistical analysis. 
Intensities below the {intensity_cutoff_pct}{intensity_cutoff_suffix} percentile of all 
intensities in the table were treated as missing. Within each experimental group a protein 
failed if the share of its values that were missing exceeded the allowed share, {missing_vals_cutoff}% (shown rounded to three decimals); {cross_groups_text} 
The data matrix was then log (base 2) transformed and between-sample normalisation 
were performed using the '{norm_method}' method from the 'limma' R package 
(Ritchie et al., 2015).

{numbers$ruv_design_methods %||% ruv_text}{ruv_count_text}

At each stage of the data normalisation, the samples were checked for batch effects 
using principal component analysis (PCA) plot, density boxplots, relative 
log-expression (RLE) plots and the distribution of the Pearson correlation between 
replicate samples within groups.

Test conditions, deviations from the method and critical reagent details: [to be completed by the analyst].  ",
.trim = FALSE)
}
```

```{r Result Section, echo=FALSE}
# UPDATED: Results function - focuses on correlation data (conditional on RUV status)
FormatResults <- function(correlation_data,
                         figures_dir = file.path(results_dir, "protein_qc"),
                         ruv_applied = TRUE) {
  ruv_state <- if (isTRUE(ruv_applied)) TRUE else if (isFALSE(ruv_applied)) FALSE else NA # KIT-227: NA = not recorded
  # KIT-055: the text describes what Figure 1 contains; it makes no claim about what this dataset's panels show.
  # Interpretation belongs to the analyst (see "Analyst interpretation").
  if (isTRUE(ruv_state)) {
    glue::glue("
Quality Control  

Figure 1 shows four quality-control views at three stages of processing: after log2 transformation
(left column: panels a, d, g, j), after between-sample normalisation (centre column: b, e, h, k) and
after RUVIII-C correction (right column: c, f, i, l).  
• Principal component analysis (panels a-c): samples plotted on the first two principal components,
  coloured by experimental group.  
• Density plots (panels d-f): the distribution of protein intensities per sample.  
• Relative log expression (panels g-i): per-sample deviations from the protein-wise median.  
• Pearson correlation (panels j-l): the distribution of between-sample correlations within groups.  

Whether technical variation was reduced and biological signal retained is assessed from these panels
by the analyst; this report draws no automated conclusion from them. ",
.trim = FALSE)
  } else if (is.na(ruv_state)) {
    # KIT-227: RUV not recorded: the figure's column layout is not known, so no stages are named.
    glue::glue("
Quality Control  

Figure 1 shows four quality-control views at each stage of processing drawn for this analysis. Whether RUV-III correction was applied is not recorded for this analysis.  
• Principal component analysis: samples plotted on the first two principal components,
  coloured by experimental group.  
• Density plots: the distribution of protein intensities per sample.  
• Relative log expression: per-sample deviations from the protein-wise median.  
• Pearson correlation: the distribution of between-sample correlations within groups.  

Whether technical variation was reduced and biological signal retained is assessed from these panels
by the analyst; this report draws no automated conclusion from them. ",
.trim = FALSE)
  } else {
    glue::glue("
Quality Control  

Figure 1 shows four quality-control views at two stages of processing: after log2 transformation
(left column: panels a, c, e, g) and after between-sample normalisation (right column: b, d, f, h).
RUV-III correction was not applied to this dataset.  
• Principal component analysis (panels a-b): samples plotted on the first two principal components,
  coloured by experimental group.  
• Density plots (panels c-d): the distribution of protein intensities per sample.  
• Relative log expression (panels e-f): per-sample deviations from the protein-wise median.  
• Pearson correlation (panels g-h): the distribution of between-sample correlations within groups.  

Whether technical variation was reduced and biological signal retained is assessed from these panels
by the analyst; this report draws no automated conclusion from them. ",
.trim = FALSE)
  }
}
```

```{r Differential Abundance Section, echo=FALSE}
# UPDATED: DE details using new UI and S4 parameters
FormatDEDetails <- function(numbers) {
  # Get UI parameters with S4 fallbacks
  ui_q_val_thresh <- numbers$ui_de_q_value_threshold %||% numbers$s4_de_q_val_thresh %||% 0.05
  
  # S4 parameters
  ebayes_trend_val <- numbers$s4_ebayes_trend %||% TRUE
  ebayes_robust_val <- numbers$s4_ebayes_robust %||% TRUE
  formula_string_val <- numbers$s4_formula_string %||% "~ 0 + group"

  # KIT-236 (D20): the fold-change threshold as it was tested (the record's model, else the DA UI block, else the cutoff).
  treat_desc <- ReportTreatSentence(ReportTreatState(numbers))
  # KIT-236 (D11): the FDR method of each comparison where the record names it, else the rule.
  fdr_text <- ReportFdrSentence(numbers)
  # KIT-236 (D10): the technical-replicate block, when the record holds it.
  block_text <- ReportBlockClause(numbers, per_assay = FALSE)
  
  trend_robust <- c()
  if(isTRUE(ebayes_trend_val)) trend_robust <- c(trend_robust, "trended")
  if(isTRUE(ebayes_robust_val)) trend_robust <- c(trend_robust, "robust")
  
  trend_robust_text <- if(length(trend_robust) > 0) {
    paste("A", paste(trend_robust, collapse = " and "), "empirical Bayes analysis was performed.")
  } else {
    "A standard empirical Bayes analysis was performed."
  }
  
  glue::glue("
DIFFERENTIAL ABUNDANCE ANALYSIS

Differential abundance analysis of proteins was performed using the adjusted 
abundance matrix for the comparisons defined in the contrast table. The 'limma' R 
package (Ritchie et al., 2015) was used. A linear model was fitted using the formula '{formula_string_val}' with the 
'lmFit' function, and p-values were calculated using the 'eBayes' function.{block_text} 
{trend_robust_text} {fdr_text} 
{treat_desc} Significant differentially expressed proteins were defined as those 
with q-values less than {ui_q_val_thresh}.

Volcano plots of differentially expressed proteins across all groups are shown 
in Figure 3, with a threshold of q-value < {ui_q_val_thresh} and no log fold-change 
threshold. Full details of all proteins are provided in the supplementary results
table DA_results_{params$omic_type}.xlsx within the Publication_tables folder.",
.trim = FALSE)
}
```

```{r GO Enrichment Section, echo=FALSE}
# UPDATED: GO enrichment using new organism and UI parameters
FormatGOEnrichment <- function(numbers) {
  # Extract organism info (if available in future iterations)
  organism_name_val <- "the species under study" # Default since not in current format
  taxon_id_val <- numbers$ui_enrichment_organism_selected %||% NA
  
  # Get UI enrichment parameters
  up_lfc_val <- numbers$ui_enrichment_up_lfc %||% 0
  down_lfc_val <- numbers$ui_enrichment_down_lfc %||% 0
  q_val_cutoff_val <- numbers$ui_enrichment_q_value_cutoff %||% 0.05
  database_source_val <- numbers$ui_enrichment_database_source %||% "N/A"

  taxon_info <- if (!is.na(taxon_id_val)) glue::glue(" (NCBI Taxonomy ID: {taxon_id_val})") else ""

  background_info <- glue::glue(
    "• The background protein set consisted of all identified proteins from ",
    "{organism_name_val}{taxon_info} that passed the quality control filtering steps."
  )

  # Text for LFC cutoffs used to define gene sets
  lfc_text <- if (up_lfc_val > 0 || down_lfc_val < 0) {
      glue::glue(
          "• Upregulated proteins were defined as those with a log2 fold-change > {up_lfc_val}. ",
          "Downregulated proteins were defined as those with a log2 fold-change < {down_lfc_val}."
      )
  } else {
      "• No fold change cutoff was applied to filter differentially expressed proteins."
  }

  # KIT-173: the run records its method as "gprofiler2" or "clusterprofiler"; "gprofiler" is the legacy literal.
  is_gprofiler <- isTRUE(database_source_val %in% c("gprofiler2", "gprofiler"))
  is_clusterprofiler <- identical(database_source_val, "clusterprofiler")
  # KIT-205 (VAL-129 (2)): the background rule the run recorded. A record without it was made before the rule, with
  # every row of each comparison's table; a report without a record describes the current rule (the tested proteins).
  every_row <- isTRUE(numbers$record_present) && !identical(numbers$enrichment_background %||% NA, "tested")

  enrichment_tool_text <- if (database_source_val == "gprofiler") {
    # g:Profiler text
    glue::glue("The enrichment analysis was performed using the g:Profiler toolset ",
    "via the gprofiler2 R package (Kolberg et al., 2023). For each GO category ",
    "(Biological Process, Molecular Function, and Cellular Component), terms were ",
    "considered significantly enriched if they had an adjusted p-value less than ",
    "{q_val_cutoff_val} after multiple testing correction using the g:SCS method.")
  } else {
    # clusterProfiler text (default)
    glue::glue("The enrichment analysis was performed using the clusterProfiler R package ",
    "(Yu et al., 2012). For each GO category (Biological Process, Molecular Function, ",
    "and Cellular Component), terms were considered significantly enriched if they had ",
    "an adjusted p-value less than {q_val_cutoff_val} after multiple testing correction ",
    "using the Benjamini-Hochberg method.")
  }
  parameter_bullets <- paste0(lfc_text, "\n", "• An adjusted FDR cutoff of ", q_val_cutoff_val,
    " was used to identify significantly enriched GO terms", "\n", background_info)

  if (is_clusterprofiler || is_gprofiler) {
    # KIT-173 (B15): the cutoffs the kernel applies (log2FC > up, log2FC < -down, among DA q-values below the cutoff).
    lfc_text <- if (up_lfc_val > 0 || abs(down_lfc_val) > 0) glue::glue("• Up-regulated proteins were those with a log2 fold-change above {up_lfc_val} and down-regulated proteins those below -{abs(down_lfc_val)}, among proteins with a differential-abundance q-value below {q_val_cutoff_val}.") else glue::glue("• Up- and down-regulated proteins were those with a positive or negative log2 fold-change among proteins with a differential-abundance q-value below {q_val_cutoff_val}; no fold-change cutoff was applied.")
  }
  if (is_clusterprofiler) {
    # KIT-173 (D3, D7): the route's sets, family, significance flag and background, as the run recorded them.
    go_propagation_val <- numbers$enrichment_go_propagation %||% NA
    relations_val <- c(is_a_part_of = "is a, part of",
      is_a_part_of_regulates = "is a, part of, regulates, positively regulates, negatively regulates")
    propagated <- is.character(go_propagation_val) && length(go_propagation_val) == 1L &&
      go_propagation_val %in% names(relations_val)
    go_sets_text <- ""
    if (propagated) {
      go_sets_text <- glue::glue("Gene Ontology protein sets were built from UniProt annotations. Each term's set ",
        "also includes the proteins annotated to its more specific terms (Gene Ontology release ",
        "{numbers$enrichment_go_source_date %||% 'not recorded'}, GO.db {numbers$enrichment_go_db_version %||% 'not recorded'}; ",
        "relations followed: {relations_val[[go_propagation_val]]}).")
      lost_val <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(numbers$enrichment_go_ids_not_in_go_db_total %||% NA))
      if (length(lost_val) == 1L && !is.na(lost_val)) {
        go_sets_text <- paste0(go_sets_text, " ", lost_val, " annotated terms that this release does not contain were not used.")
      }
      go_sets_text <- paste0(go_sets_text, " ")
    }
    background_clause <- if (propagated) " (on a run with parent terms, at least one below the three top-level terms)" else ""
    parameter_bullets <- lfc_text
    # KIT-203: the significance rule the run recorded (declared, else the rule it recorded as applied); a record
    # carrying neither was made with the q-value.
    family_rule <- identical(numbers$enrichment_significance_rule %||% NA, "bh_whole_family")
    family_members <- if (every_row) "annotated proteins of that comparison's differential-abundance table" else
      "annotated tested proteins"
    family_text <- if (family_rule) paste0("terms with 10 to 500 ", family_members, ", whether or not a listed ",
      "protein falls in them (terms without one enter with p = 1).") else paste0("terms with 10 to 500 ",
      family_members, " and at least one protein in the list.")
    background_text <- if (every_row) paste0("The background was every protein listed in that comparison's ",
      "differential-abundance table, including any without a p-value, with at least one Gene Ontology annotation") else
      paste0("The background was the proteins tested in that comparison (those with a p-value) with at least one Gene ",
      "Ontology annotation")
    flag_text <- if (family_rule) glue::glue("A term was called significant when its Benjamini-Hochberg adjusted ",
      "p-value over that family was below {q_val_cutoff_val}; Storey's q-value and the Benjamini-Hochberg value over ",
      "the terms with at least one listed protein are also given in the results table.") else
      glue::glue("A term was called significant when its q-value (Storey, 2002) was below {q_val_cutoff_val}; ",
      "Benjamini-Hochberg adjusted p-values are also given in the results table.")
    # The measured limits: after the flag sentence under the default, after the paragraph for the q-value.
    limits_text <- if (family_rule) paste0(" In simulations through this route at a cutoff of 0.05 (lists drawn at ",
      "random from the reviewed UniProt proteomes of E. coli K-12, a 2,000-protein subset of it, and S. cerevisiae, ",
      "the last run through this route as a stand-in; lists of 25, 126 and 400 proteins; with parent terms over the ",
      "five relations and without them; 2,000 random lists per setting), 1.0 % to 2.5 % of random lists had any ",
      "significant term, and on lists of 126 built around one process the mean false discovery proportion was at ",
      "most 1.7 % (in a design where the other listed proteins avoid that process, which tends to lower false calls). ",
      "Not simulated: down lists, other cutoffs, lists of proteins that change together as in real data, other ",
      "organisms or annotation sources, and parent terms over is a and part of only. Transcriptomics tests sets of 5 ",
      "to 500 genes; this route 10 to 500 proteins.") else paste0(" Because terms without a list protein are left ",
      "out before the adjustment, the estimated share of true null terms falls far below 1 on many random lists; on ",
      "simulated random lists at a cutoff of 0.05 the share of lists with any significant term was 1.7 % to 42.9 % ",
      "depending on the proteome, list size and parent terms (failing a 7.5 % line in 6 of 18 settings, two of them ",
      "with parent terms, both with lists of 25 proteins), against 1.6 % to 8.2 % for Benjamini-Hochberg over the ",
      "same terms.")
    enrichment_tool_text <- glue::glue("{go_sets_text}Over-representation was tested with clusterProfiler (Yu et al., ",
      "2012) against Gene Ontology annotations from UniProt. Biological process, molecular function and cellular ",
      "component terms were tested together as one family per comparison and direction: {family_text} {flag_text}",
      "{if (family_rule) limits_text else ''} {background_text}{background_clause}.",
      "{if (family_rule) '' else limits_text}")
  } else if (is_gprofiler) {
    # KIT-173: the corrected g:Profiler paragraph; the correction is named from the analysis record when there is one.
    correction_val <- numbers$enrichment_correction_method %||% NA
    correction_names <- c(gSCS = "g:SCS", fdr = "Benjamini-Hochberg false discovery rate", bonferroni = "Bonferroni")
    correction_text <- if (is.character(correction_val) && length(correction_val) == 1L && !is.na(correction_val) &&
      !identical(correction_val, "not recorded")) {
      paste0("with ", if (correction_val %in% names(correction_names)) correction_names[[correction_val]] else correction_val,
        " correction of the p-values")
    } else {
      "with the correction selected for the run (g:SCS unless the Benjamini-Hochberg false discovery rate was chosen)"
    }
    # KIT-208 (E-7): a protein without a gene name is never sent as its accession; it leaves the lists and background.
    named_clause <- paste0("the first gene name of each protein, from the protein annotation or, where the annotation ",
      "gives none, from the identifier table; proteins without a gene name were left out of the lists and the background")
    parameter_bullets <- paste0(lfc_text, "\n",
      "• A term was called significant when its adjusted p-value was below ", q_val_cutoff_val, ".", "\n",
      if (every_row) paste0("• The background was the identifiers of each comparison's differential-abundance table (",
        named_clause, ") that g:Profiler recognises (a custom background).") else
        paste0("• The background was the identifiers of the proteins tested in each comparison (those with a p-value ",
        "in its differential-abundance table; ", named_clause, ") that g:Profiler recognises (a custom background)."))
    enrichment_tool_text <- glue::glue("The enrichment analysis was performed with g:Profiler (Kolberg et al., 2023) ",
      "through the gprofiler2 R package (Kolberg et al., 2020). Gene Ontology biological process, molecular function ",
      "and cellular component terms, KEGG pathways and Reactome pathways were tested, each data source as its own ",
      "family, {correction_text}. On g:Profiler, a list for which no term is significant cannot be told apart from ",
      "a list in which the service recognised none of the gene names.") # KIT-215 (VAL-170 (6))
  }
  # KIT-215 (VAL-170): the lists the run recorded as not tested, with the route's reason (each route has one); printed
  # only when the record holds the outcome (the report map turns an absent outcome into "not recorded").
  not_tested_val <- numbers$enrichment_lists_not_tested
  if ((is_clusterprofiler || is_gprofiler) && is.character(not_tested_val) && length(not_tested_val) == 1L &&
    !is.na(not_tested_val) && nzchar(not_tested_val) && !identical(not_tested_val, "not recorded")) {
    not_tested_lists <- sub("^(.*): (up|down)$", "\\1 (\\2-regulated)",
      strsplit(not_tested_val, "; ", fixed = TRUE)[[1L]])
    not_tested_reason <- if (is_clusterprofiler) {
      "none of its proteins has a Gene Ontology annotation that this analysis tests"
    } else {
      "none of its proteins has a gene name, and g:Profiler tests gene names"
    }
    parameter_bullets <- paste0(parameter_bullets, "\n", "• Not tested: ", paste(not_tested_lists, collapse = "; "),
      ": ", not_tested_reason, ". A list that was not tested has no result; its absence from the results does not ",
      "mean that no term is enriched.")
  }
  
  glue::glue("
GO ENRICHMENT ANALYSIS

Gene Ontology (GO) enrichment analysis was performed on the differentially 
expressed proteins to identify significantly enriched biological processes, 
molecular functions, and cellular components. The analysis was conducted using the 
following parameters:
{parameter_bullets}

{enrichment_tool_text}

Key findings from the GO enrichment analysis are summarised below for each 
comparison:

Biological Process:


Molecular Function:


Cellular Component:


The complete list of enriched GO terms with statistics is provided in the 
supplementary file 'Pathway_enrichment_results.xlsx' within the Publication_tables 
folder.",
.trim = FALSE)
}
```

```{r Sample Analysis Functions, echo=FALSE}
# KIT-236: the facts the report's computed sentences read. The analysis record beside study_parameters.txt is read
# here directly (as KIT-227 reads its steps; the overlay maps none of these fields), then the design table, then the
# file. A source that is absent leaves its field NULL or NA, and the sentence says it is not recorded or is left out.
ReportKnown <- function(x) {
  !is.null(x) && length(x) == 1L && !is.list(x) && !is.na(x) &&
    !trimws(as.character(x)) %in% c("", "N/A", "NA", "not recorded")
}

#' A file's state: TRUE or FALSE when the report's directory is known, NA when it is not (a chunk run alone)
ReportFileState <- function(dir_name, file) {
  base <- get0(dir_name, ifnotfound = NULL)
  if (is.null(base)) return(NA)
  file.exists(file.path(base, file))
}

#' The image files in a report directory's subfolder (none when the directory is not known)
ReportImages <- function(dir_name, folder) {
  base <- get0(dir_name, ifnotfound = NULL)
  if (is.null(base)) return(character())
  list.files(file.path(base, folder), pattern = "[.](png|jpg|jpeg)$", ignore.case = TRUE)
}

ReportRecordFacts <- function(design_matrix, study_params) {
  source_dir <- get0("report_source_dir", ifnotfound = NULL)
  record_path <- if (is.null(source_dir)) "" else file.path(source_dir, "analysis_record.json")
  record <- if (nzchar(record_path) && file.exists(record_path)) {
    tryCatch(jsonlite::read_json(record_path, simplifyVector = FALSE), error = function(e) NULL)
  } else NULL
  decode <- function(value) tryCatch(MultiScholaR:::decodeWorkflowRecordValue(value), error = function(e) NULL)
  facts <- list(record_present = !is.null(record))
  # The design: the record's analysed rows, else the design table. A technical-replicate set is a value of the
  # declared technical_replicate_id (tech_rep_group on the application's route) shared by two or more runs.
  rows <- record$design$rows
  if (length(rows)) {
    column <- record$design$technical_replicate_id
    ids <- if (ReportKnown(column)) vapply(rows, function(row) {
      value <- row[[column]]
      if (is.null(value)) NA_character_ else as.character(value)
    }, "") else NULL
    facts$design <- list(source = "record", runs = length(rows), ids = ids)
  } else if (is.data.frame(design_matrix) && nrow(design_matrix) > 0L) {
    ids <- if ("tech_rep_group" %in% names(design_matrix)) as.character(design_matrix$tech_rep_group) else NULL
    facts$design <- list(source = "file", runs = nrow(design_matrix), ids = ids)
  }
  da <- record$analyses$differential_abundance
  model <- da$model
  facts$treat_applied <- if (is.logical(model$treat_applied) && length(model$treat_applied) == 1L) model$treat_applied else NA
  facts$block_reason <- if (ReportKnown(model$block_reason)) as.character(model$block_reason) else NA_character_
  # The comparisons: the record's, else contrast_strings.tab beside the file, else the summary's contrasts_tbl.tab.
  raw <- character()
  friendly <- character()
  if (length(da$contrasts)) {
    raw <- vapply(da$contrasts, function(x) as.character(x$contrasts %||% NA_character_), "")
    friendly <- vapply(da$contrasts, function(x) as.character(x$friendly_names %||% x$contrasts %||% NA_character_), "")
  } else {
    strings_path <- if (is.null(source_dir)) "" else file.path(source_dir, "contrast_strings.tab")
    summary_dir <- get0("report_results_summary_dir", ifnotfound = NULL)
    table_path <- if (is.null(summary_dir)) "" else file.path(summary_dir, "Study_report", "contrasts_tbl.tab")
    if (nzchar(strings_path) && file.exists(strings_path)) {
      raw <- trimws(readLines(strings_path, warn = FALSE))
      raw <- raw[nzchar(raw)]
      friendly <- gsub(".", "_", gsub("-", "_vs_", gsub("-group", "-", gsub("^group", "", raw))), fixed = TRUE)
    } else if (nzchar(table_path) && file.exists(table_path)) {
      table <- tryCatch(utils::read.delim(table_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE),
        error = function(e) NULL)
      if (is.data.frame(table) && nrow(table) > 0L) {
        raw <- as.character(table[[if ("contrasts" %in% names(table)) "contrasts" else 1L]])
        friendly <- if ("friendly_names" %in% names(table)) as.character(table$friendly_names) else raw
      }
    }
  }
  facts$contrasts <- stats::setNames(friendly, raw)
  # The FDR method of each comparison (and assay), where the record carries it.
  results <- Filter(function(x) !is.null(x$fdr_method), da$results %||% list())
  if (length(results)) {
    facts$fdr <- data.frame(
      contrast = vapply(results, function(x) as.character(x$contrast %||% NA_character_), ""),
      assay = vapply(results, function(x) as.character(x$assay %||% NA_character_), ""),
      fdr_method = vapply(results, function(x) as.character(x$fdr_method), ""), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }
  # The features remaining after each step: the record's step dimensions (rows, summed over the assays).
  steps <- record$steps %||% list()
  labels <- c(design_builder = "import and design", intensity_filter = "intensity filter",
    duplicate_resolution = "duplicate resolution", qc_finalize = "quality-control finalisation",
    itsd_normalisation = "internal-standard normalisation", log2 = "log2 transformation",
    between_sample_normalisation = "between-sample normalisation", ruv = "RUV-III correction",
    pearson_selection = "sample-correlation filter")
  counts <- character()
  for (step in steps) {
    feature_rows <- step$dimensions$rows
    if (!is.numeric(feature_rows) || length(feature_rows) != 1L) next
    operation <- as.character(step$operation %||% "")
    key <- names(labels)[vapply(names(labels), function(k) identical(operation, k) || endsWith(operation, paste0("_", k)),
      logical(1))]
    counts <- c(counts, paste(if (length(key)) labels[[key[[1L]]]] else gsub("_", " ", operation), feature_rows))
  }
  if (length(counts)) facts$step_features <- paste(counts, collapse = "; ")
  # The samples the sample-correlation filter kept, only when its step is in the record: n = the runs of the design
  # table (written before any filter), k = the samples of the record's analysed design.
  pearson <- Filter(function(step) endsWith(as.character(step$operation %||% ""), "pearson_selection"), steps)
  if (length(pearson) && length(rows) && is.data.frame(design_matrix)) {
    threshold <- Filter(function(p) identical(p$name, "min_pearson_correlation_threshold"),
      pearson[[length(pearson)]]$parameters)
    facts$samples_kept <- list(k = length(rows), n = nrow(design_matrix),
      threshold = if (length(threshold)) decode(threshold[[1L]]$value) else NULL)
  }
  # Internal standards: the assays the file lists under 'ITSD Features Per Assay' (KIT-235's parser returns the block
  # as a section of its own).
  itsd_block <- study_params[["ITSD Features Per Assay"]] %||% study_params[["ITSD Normalization"]][["ITSD Features Per Assay"]]
  facts$itsd_assays_found <- length(itsd_block)
  # Whether a between-sample normalisation method is recorded (the file, the S4 parameters or a record step).
  norm_steps <- Filter(function(step) endsWith(as.character(step$operation %||% ""), "between_sample_normalisation") ||
    identical(step$operation, "normalization-ruv"), steps)
  facts$normalisation_recorded <- ReportKnown(study_params[["Between-Sample Normalization"]][["Method"]]) ||
    ReportKnown(study_params[["Workflow Parameters"]][["Parameters from Final S4 Object"]][["normaliseBetweenSamples"]][["method"]]) ||
    length(norm_steps) > 0L
  facts
}

#' The sample-details sentence (D5): the analysed design from the record, else the design table
ReportDesignText <- function(facts) {
  design <- facts$design
  if (is.null(design)) return("The design is not available to this report.")
  lead <- if (identical(design$source, "record")) "The analysis included" else "The design table lists"
  runs <- design$runs
  ids <- design$ids
  if (is.null(ids) || all(is.na(ids))) {
    return(paste0(lead, " ", runs, " samples. The design does not record which, if any, are technical replicates."))
  }
  sizes <- table(ids)
  shared <- sum(sizes > 1L)
  biological <- length(sizes)
  if (shared == 0L) {
    return(paste0(lead, " ", runs, " samples, each a separate biological sample (no technical replicates were declared ",
      "in the design)."))
  }
  paste0(lead, " ", runs, " measured runs from ", biological, " biological samples; ", shared,
    if (shared == 1L) " biological sample was" else " biological samples were",
    " measured more than once (technical replicates), giving ", runs - biological, " additional runs.")
}

#' The between-sample normalisation as the Figure 1 caption names its column (D1, D2)
ReportNormalisationWords <- function(method, recorded = TRUE) {
  if (!isTRUE(recorded) || !ReportKnown(method)) return("between-sample normalisation (the method is not recorded)")
  switch(as.character(method),
    cyclicloess = "cyclic loess normalisation (normalizeCyclicLoess)",
    quantile = "quantile normalisation (normalizeQuantiles)",
    scale = "scaling of each sample to the same median absolute value (normalizeMedianAbsValues)",
    none = "the normalisation step, at which no normalisation was applied",
    paste0("between-sample normalisation with the '", method, "' method"))
}

#' Whether a fold-change threshold (TREAT) was tested (D20): the record's model, else the DA UI block, else the cutoff.
#' `record_only`: the record's model alone (DIA with limpa, whose DPC model runs no TREAT whatever the cutoff).
ReportTreatState <- function(numbers, record_only = FALSE) {
  cutoff <- NA_real_
  for (value in list(numbers$ui_de_log_fold_change_cutoff, numbers$s4_de_treat_lfc_cutoff)) {
    if (ReportKnown(value)) {
      cutoff <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(value))
      if (!is.na(cutoff)) break
    }
  }
  applied <- numbers$report_facts$treat_applied
  if (is.logical(applied) && length(applied) == 1L && !is.na(applied)) {
    return(list(state = if (applied) "treat" else "zero", cutoff = cutoff))
  }
  if (isTRUE(record_only)) return(list(state = "unknown", cutoff = cutoff))
  enabled <- numbers$ui_de_treat_enabled
  if (is.logical(enabled) && length(enabled) == 1L && isFALSE(enabled)) return(list(state = "zero", cutoff = cutoff))
  if (is.na(cutoff)) return(list(state = "unknown", cutoff = cutoff))
  list(state = if (cutoff > 0) "treat" else "zero", cutoff = cutoff)
}

ReportTreatSentence <- function(treat) {
  if (identical(treat$state, "treat")) {
    if (is.na(treat$cutoff)) return(paste("Each comparison was tested against a log2 fold-change threshold with limma's",
      "TREAT method (McCarthy and Smyth, 2009); the threshold is not recorded."))
    return(paste0("Each comparison was tested against a log2 fold-change threshold of ", treat$cutoff,
      " with limma's TREAT method (McCarthy and Smyth, 2009)."))
  }
  if (identical(treat$state, "zero")) return("Each comparison was tested for any difference from zero log2 fold change.")
  "Whether a fold-change threshold (TREAT) was used is not recorded for this analysis."
}

#' The definition of a significant feature (D21)
ReportSignificanceSentence <- function(treat, q_value, features) {
  if (identical(treat$state, "treat") && !is.na(treat$cutoff)) {
    return(paste0("Differentially abundant ", features, " were those with a q-value below ", q_value,
      " and an absolute log2 fold change of at least ", treat$cutoff, "."))
  }
  if (identical(treat$state, "zero")) return(paste0("Differentially abundant ", features, " were those with a q-value below ",
    q_value, "."))
  paste0("Differentially abundant ", features, " were those with a q-value below ", q_value,
    "; whether a fold-change threshold also applied is not recorded.")
}

#' The false discovery rate sentence (D11): per comparison where the record names the method, else the rule
ReportFdrSentence <- function(numbers) {
  facts <- numbers$report_facts
  fdr <- facts$fdr
  if (is.null(fdr) || !nrow(fdr)) {
    return(paste("False discovery rates were estimated as q-values (Storey, 2002); where they cannot be computed,",
      "Benjamini-Hochberg adjusted p-values are used."))
  }
  fallback <- fdr[fdr$fdr_method == "BH", , drop = FALSE]
  if (!nrow(fallback)) return("False discovery rates were estimated as q-values (Storey, 2002).")
  names_of <- function(x) {
    hit <- unname(facts$contrasts[x])
    ifelse(is.na(hit), x, hit)
  }
  groups <- split(fallback, ifelse(is.na(fallback$assay), "", fallback$assay))
  parts <- vapply(groups, function(rows) {
    comparisons <- paste(unique(names_of(rows$contrast)), collapse = ", ")
    if (is.na(rows$assay[[1L]])) comparisons else paste0(comparisons, " in ", rows$assay[[1L]])
  }, "")
  paste0("False discovery rates were estimated as q-values (Storey, 2002), except for ", paste(parts, collapse = "; "),
    ", where q-values could not be computed and Benjamini-Hochberg adjusted p-values were used instead.")
}

#' The comparisons named after "the contrast table" (D10): " (1 comparison: A_vs_B)", or nothing when unknown
ReportContrastList <- function(numbers) {
  friendly <- unname(numbers$report_facts$contrasts %||% character())
  friendly <- friendly[!is.na(friendly) & nzchar(friendly)]
  if (!length(friendly)) return("")
  paste0(" (", length(friendly), if (length(friendly) == 1L) " comparison: " else " comparisons: ",
    paste(friendly, collapse = ", "), ")")
}

#' The technical-replicate block (D10): when the record's block reason contains 'technical_replicates'
ReportBlockClause <- function(numbers, per_assay = TRUE) {
  reason <- numbers$report_facts$block_reason
  if (!ReportKnown(reason)) reason <- numbers$da_block_reason
  if (!ReportKnown(reason) || !grepl("technical_replicates", reason, fixed = TRUE)) return("")
  if (isTRUE(per_assay)) {
    " Technical replicates were modelled as a block through limma's duplicateCorrelation (consensus correlation estimated per assay)."
  } else " Technical replicates were modelled as a block through limma's duplicateCorrelation."
}

# UPDATED: Sample analysis with enhanced error handling
CalculateSampleCounts <- function(group_summary) {
  # Enhanced validation
  if (is.null(group_summary) || nrow(group_summary) == 0) {
    return(list(total_samples = 0, biological_samples = 0, technical_replicates = 0))
  }
  
  total_measurements <- sum(group_summary$total_measurements, na.rm = TRUE)
  biological_samples <- sum(group_summary$n_samples, na.rm = TRUE)
  technical_replicates <- max(0, total_measurements - biological_samples)
  
  list(
    total_samples = total_measurements, 
    biological_samples = biological_samples, 
    technical_replicates = technical_replicates
  )
}

CalculatePatientMetrics <- function(numbers, group_summary) {
  # Enhanced error handling
  if (is.null(numbers) || is.null(group_summary)) return(numbers)
  
  if (numbers$biological_samples > 0) {
    numbers$avg_tech_reps_per_sample <- numbers$total_samples / numbers$biological_samples
    numbers$samples_per_group <- numbers$biological_samples / n_distinct(group_summary$group)
  } else {
    numbers$avg_tech_reps_per_sample <- 0
    numbers$samples_per_group <- 0
  }
  numbers
}

AnalyzeGroups <- function(design_df) {
  # Enhanced validation
  if (is.null(design_df) || nrow(design_df) == 0 || !"group" %in% names(design_df)) {
    return(tibble(group = character(0), n_samples = numeric(0), 
                  total_measurements = numeric(0), avg_replicates = numeric(0)))
  }
  
  unique(design_df$group) |>
    purrr::map_dfr(function(g) {
      group_data <- design_df |> 
        filter(group == g)
      unique_samples <- n_distinct(group_data$Run)
      total_rows <- nrow(group_data)
      avg_reps <- if(unique_samples == total_rows) 1 else total_rows / unique_samples
      tibble( group = g, n_samples = unique_samples, total_measurements = total_rows, avg_replicates = avg_reps )
    })
}

AnalyzeSamples <- function(design_matrix, study_params) {
  # Enhanced error handling
  tryCatch({
    group_summary <- AnalyzeGroups(design_matrix)
    numbers <- CalculateSampleCounts(group_summary)
    numbers <- CalculatePatientMetrics(numbers, group_summary)
    params_extracted <- ExtractStudyParametersNew(study_params)
    # KIT-033: the analysis record, when it sits beside study_parameters.txt, supplies the values it carries.
    params_extracted <- MultiScholaR:::workflowRecordReportParameters(file.path(report_source_dir, "analysis_record.json"),
      params_extracted, study_params)
    # KIT-227: the RUV step's own parameters (stored encoded; the overlay does not map them): the mode, the analyst's
    # percentage and the grouping the RUV sentence states.
    record_ruv_path <- file.path(report_source_dir, "analysis_record.json")
    record_ruv_steps <- if (file.exists(record_ruv_path)) Filter(function(step) identical(step$operation, "normalization-ruv"),
      jsonlite::read_json(record_ruv_path, simplifyVector = FALSE)$steps) else list()
    record_ruv_parameter <- function(name) {
      hit <- if (length(record_ruv_steps)) Filter(function(parameter) identical(parameter$name, name),
        record_ruv_steps[[length(record_ruv_steps)]]$parameters) else list()
      if (length(hit)) MultiScholaR:::decodeWorkflowRecordValue(hit[[1L]]$value) else NULL
    }
    params_extracted$record_ruv_mode <- record_ruv_parameter("ruv_mode")
    params_extracted$record_ruv_percentage <- record_ruv_parameter("ruv_percentage")
    params_extracted$record_ruv_grouping <- record_ruv_parameter("grouping")
    
    # Combine base counts/metrics with extracted params
    final_numbers <- c(numbers, params_extracted)
    
    # Replace any NULLs with NA to prevent errors downstream
    final_numbers[sapply(final_numbers, is.null)] <- NA
    # KIT-236: the record and design facts of the computed sentences (ReportRecordFacts)
    final_numbers$report_facts <- tryCatch(ReportRecordFacts(design_matrix, study_params), error = function(e) list())
    # KIT-129 sixth pass item 6: a new RUV design's methods sentence, from the study parameters' section
    # "Unwanted variation (RUV)" (absent for today's design, whose text is unchanged)
    ruv_design_methods <- safe_extract(study_params, c("Unwanted variation (RUV)", "Methods text"), NULL)
    if (is.character(ruv_design_methods) && length(ruv_design_methods) == 1L && nzchar(ruv_design_methods)) final_numbers$ruv_design_methods <- ruv_design_methods
    
    list( numbers = final_numbers, table = group_summary )
  }, error = function(e) {
    # Return default structure on error
    list(numbers = list(), table = data.frame())
  })
}

# NEW: Format DE Summary Table
FormatDESummaryTable <- function(filepath) {
  if (!file.exists(filepath)) return("")
  
  tryCatch({
    data <- readr::read_tsv(filepath, show_col_types = FALSE)
    
    # Filter for significant
    sig_data <- data %>% 
      dplyr::filter(status %in% c("Significant and Up", "Significant and Down"))
    
    if (nrow(sig_data) == 0) return("No significant differentially expressed proteins were found.")
    
    summary_text <- sig_data %>%
      dplyr::group_by(comparison) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(
        up = sum(counts[status == "Significant and Up"]),
        down = sum(counts[status == "Significant and Down"]),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        text = glue::glue("For the comparison {comparison}, there were {up} upregulated and {down} downregulated proteins.")
      ) %>%
      dplyr::pull(text) %>%
      paste(collapse = " ")
      
    # KIT-220 (VAL-191 (7)): the sentence states the threshold its counts were made at; a table written before the
    # q_threshold column existed was counted at 0.05.
    q_threshold <- if ("q_threshold" %in% names(data)) paste(unique(data$q_threshold), collapse = ", ") else "0.05"
    return(paste0("The number of significant differentially expressed proteins is summarised in Figure 2 (q-value < ",
      q_threshold, "). ", summary_text))
  }, error = function(e) {
    return(paste("Error reading DE summary table:", e$message))
  })
}
```

```{r Main Execution Function, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# UPDATED: Main function using new parser
Main <- function() {
  # Use globally available path variables
  params_path <- file.path(report_source_dir, "study_parameters.txt")
  if (!file.exists(params_path)) stop(glue::glue("Study parameters file not found: {params_path}"))
  
  # Use NEW hierarchical parser
  study_params_data <- tryCatch({ 
    ReadStudyParamsNew(params_path) 
  }, error = function(e) { 
    stop(glue::glue("Error reading study parameters with new parser: {e$message}")) 
  })

  matrix_path <- file.path(report_source_dir, "design_matrix.tab")
  if (!file.exists(matrix_path)) stop(glue::glue("Design matrix file not found: {matrix_path}"))
  design_matrix_data <- tryCatch({ 
    readr::read_tsv(matrix_path, show_col_types = FALSE) 
  }, error = function(e) { 
    stop(glue::glue("Error reading design matrix: {e$message}")) 
  })
  
  # Correlation data - check for both RUV and non-RUV filenames
  ruv_corr_path <- file.path(report_publication_tables_dir, "ruv_normalised_results.RDS")
  norm_corr_path <- file.path(report_publication_tables_dir, "normalised_results.RDS")
  
  # Try RUV filename first, then fall back to normalised filename
  corr_path <- if (file.exists(ruv_corr_path)) {
    ruv_corr_path
  } else if (file.exists(norm_corr_path)) {
    norm_corr_path
  } else {
    ruv_corr_path  # Default to RUV path for error message
  }
  
  correlation_data <- if (file.exists(corr_path)) {
    tryCatch({ readRDS(corr_path) }, error = function(e) { warning(glue::glue("Error reading RDS: {e$message}")); list() })
  } else { warning(glue::glue("File not found: {corr_path} (also checked: {norm_corr_path})")); list() }
  
  # Run analysis using UPDATED AnalyzeSamples with new parser
  analysis_results <- tryCatch({ 
    AnalyzeSamples(design_matrix_data, study_params_data) 
  }, error = function(e) { 
    stop(glue::glue("Error in AnalyzeSamples: {e$message}")) 
  })
  
  # NEW: Get DE summary text
  de_summary_path <- file.path(report_publication_tables_dir, paste0("da_", params$omic_type, "_num_sig_da_molecules.tab")) # KIT-055: the name the copy writes
  if (!file.exists(de_summary_path)) de_summary_path <- file.path(report_publication_tables_dir, paste0("de_", params$omic_type, "_num_sig_de_molecules.tab"))
  de_summary_text <- FormatDESummaryTable(de_summary_path)
  
  # Generate text sections using UPDATED Format* functions
  report_content <- list(
    content = list(
      sample_details = FormatSampleDetails(analysis_results$numbers),
      method_details = paste0(FormatMethodDetails(analysis_results$numbers),
        if (is.character(analysis_results$numbers$record_defaults_note) && !is.na(analysis_results$numbers$record_defaults_note))
          analysis_results$numbers$record_defaults_note else ""),
      results        = FormatResults(correlation_data, ruv_applied = analysis_results$numbers$ruv_applied %||% NA), # KIT-227: NA = not recorded
      interpretation = FormatAnalystInterpretation(),
      de_details     = FormatDEDetails(analysis_results$numbers),
      de_summary     = de_summary_text,
      go_enrichment  = FormatGOEnrichment(analysis_results$numbers)
    ),
    table = analysis_results$table,
    numbers = analysis_results$numbers
  )
  return(report_content)
}

# Execute Main to get report data
results_data <- tryCatch({ 
  Main() 
}, error = function(e) {
  list(content = list(
    sample_details = paste("Error running Main function:", e$message), 
    method_details = "", 
    results = "", 
    interpretation = "", 
    de_details = "", 
    de_summary = "",
    go_enrichment = ""
  ), table = data.frame(), numbers = list())
})
```

```{r NumSigDE_Plot, echo=FALSE, out.width="100%", fig.align='center'}
num_sig_dir <- file.path(report_publication_figures_dir, "NumSigDaMolecules")
if(dir.exists(num_sig_dir)) {
  all_sig_files <- list.files(num_sig_dir, pattern = "\\.png$", full.names = TRUE)
  # Prefer the "with_not_significant" version if it exists
  sig_plot_file <- grep("with_not_significant", all_sig_files, value = TRUE)
  if (length(sig_plot_file) == 0) {
     sig_plot_file <- all_sig_files
  }
  
  if(length(sig_plot_file) > 0) {
    knitr::include_graphics(sig_plot_file[1])
  } else {
    message(glue::glue("Warning: No NumSigDA Plot images found in {num_sig_dir}\n"))
  }
} else {
  message(glue::glue("Warning: NumSigDaMolecules directory not found at {num_sig_dir}\n"))
}
```
